en: A color postcard showing the front view of a large Romanesque-style cathedral with two tall square towers and a green roof, framed by trees and a landscaped park in the foreground. People are visible near the main entrance. The reverse side has standard postcard layout with address lines and stamp boxes, and printed information identifying the subject as the cathedral in Pécs, plus the photographer's credit.
